comment: Dr.vR is an amazing professor. He is very knowledgeable and a very nice guy. The tests are pretty difficult if you do not essentially know various details from the slides [really, really review the slides]. The second half of the semester was fully participation-based, minus the final. The quizzes are take-home. Would def take his class again!

CvR is a straightforward "evolutionary anthropologist" who approaches the 300 course from an evolutionary and ancestral community lens. He definitely knows his stuff. While the class itself isn't too difficult, the tests can be needlessly cumbersome and may fixate on topics rarely discussed in class (everything on the slides can be and is used).

he's so funny to me and i really enjoyed lectures even tho they got lengthy sometimes. i feel like the activities in class were really funny esp the debates and simulations. fair grader and an easy gen ed… would recommend!
Great LDST 102 professor. Super passionate and fair grader.

He's a nice guy, but I hated how he structured the grading of his class. The concepts are very interesting, but he overcomplicated them, and they were hard to grasp. Beware: take-home quizzes are HARD. your grade is mainly a midterm exam and final paper. The midterm was very confusingly written. if you do badly, it is hard to bring up your grade.
great guy, hard class but just participate

Honestly, he's a nice guy but the tests are just so random that they are hard to study for. They aren't difficult but the questions pull from the most random things we might have touched on maybe once in class.

Awesome! You can tell he really cares about his students and is excited to learn. He often had memes on his ppts which were not gen z humor-like but you could tell he was so excited to show them to us and get our reactions. I was always happy to be around him and he is the most humble and amazing guy!
